items.confound_note: Every case reports a fall in shoulder pain scores, not a gain in shoulder range of motion: 14 points at Marbeck, 11 at Colvane, 16 at Drenholm and 9 at Pellamere are all movements on a pain scale. Pain and range of motion are different quantities, and a stiff shoulder can hurt much less while abduction stays exactly where it was. The claim is about restoring range of motion, so none of the four ward records speaks to it.
items.notes: Closer is verbatim the TRUE closer and the conditions are identical to diverse_true.
